title: mock-knight configuration
description: Configuration for the mock-knight CLI. Every field is optional; a command-line flag always overrides the equivalent here. String values may reference environment variables as ${env:VAR} — use it for authSecret so the file you commit holds a variable name rather than a password.

$schema.description: Ignored at runtime; present so editors with JSON Schema support offer completion and validation for this file.

host.description: Bind address for the server. Anything other than the loopback default (127.0.0.1) prints a warning, since Mock Knight has no authentication of its own.

port.description: Port the server listens on. Defaults to 7777.

mode.description: 'local' or 'deployed'. Inferred from the bind address when omitted; 'deployed' refuses to start with a non-loopback host while any profile holds a stored credential, unless --allow-stored-credentials is passed.

state.description: Path to the SQLite state database. Relative paths resolve against this config file, not the working directory. Defaults to ~/.mock-knight/state.db.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts this instance may connect to. Absent means no restriction; an empty array means nothing is reachable.

profiles.description: Servers to connect to on startup, reconciled by name on every start — the way to share a set of servers with a team through version control.

name.description: Display name shown in the switcher and profile chrome.

adapter.description: Which backend this profile talks to: wiremock, mockserver, mockoon or prism.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the mock server. A context path is kept — https://host/ctx calls https://host/ctx/__admin by default.

adminPath.description: Path appended to the base URL to reach the admin API, for a server whose admin API is not at the default. Defaults to /__admin.

colour.description: Colour badge for this profile in the switcher and header chrome.

protected.description: When true, every destructive operation is absent from the UI and refused by the server. The only way to change that is editing the profile — there is no in-session override.

readOnly.description: When true, every write route for this profile returns 404, as if it did not exist.

mappingsDir.description: Path to the corpus file for a document-backed backend (Mockoon's environment JSON, Prism's OpenAPI document). Required for those backends, unused otherwise.

authKind.description: How this profile authenticates to the admin API: none, bearer, basic, or headers. Only WireMock currently accepts one.

authUsername.description: Username for basic auth. Only used when authKind is basic.

authSecret.description: The password or token itself. Kept in memory for the run unless "remember" is chosen, in which case it is written to the state database in plain text. In a shared config file, reference an environment variable instead, e.g. "${env:VAR}".

correlationHeader.description: Name of a request header (e.g. a trace or test-run ID) used to group one batch of traffic together on the Traffic screen.

redactHeaders.description: Header names replaced with a placeholder in the structured request record shown on the Traffic screen before a journal entry is stored.
